headline: JetBlue Director Peter Boneparth Acquires $300,000 in Shares
summary: JetBlue director Peter Boneparth purchased $300,000 worth of company shares in an open-market transaction.
why: Insider purchases by corporate directors are often monitored by investors as a signal of internal confidence in the airline's future outlook and valuation.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways Corporation
impacts.why: Open-market share purchases by corporate insiders signal management confidence.
